name: ssplayer-example
//dependencies: Five of these are pinned by the `overrides` in pnpm-workspace.yaml and are
NOT the registry's to move: react, react-native, @shopify/react-native-skia,
react-native-reanimated, react-native-worklets. Their version comes from the
Expo compatibility table this app installs against, so a range raised here
past the pin claims a version the install never gives it. Dependabot is told
to skip them; `pnpm update` is not. Move them by hand, with the overrides and
the package's peerDependencies, when the Expo SDK moves. The rest are ordinary.
